text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After the hit fantasy movie ended,
Tamamo Cross seemed a little off."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Tama-chan and Trainer-san.
What a coincidence seeing you here~.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Were you watching 'The Wizard Ao and the Wonderful Secret Island'?
That was a good one!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: O-O-Oh! If it ain't Oguri and Creek! What a coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: There were so many strange and cute creatures; it was so soothing~

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
There was also a girl with flowers blooming on her head.
I wonder if she waters them every morning.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Y-Y-Yeah, totally... It was fun, kinda like a mystical zoo. Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, uh...
...I'll, uh, go look at some house plants!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross tries to scurry off.
Chasing after her in a panic—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Phew...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Trainer!
Nah, I'm totally fit as a fiddle, but—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh.
Yeah, okay, maybe I'm not totally in tip-top shape.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The thing is... I can't stand sticky stuff.
Even just looking at natto gives me the creeps.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...It's a story from when I was a kid. I had this pudding
I was saving. I kept it safe, waiting for the right time to eat it, but before I knew it—

text_block_list.name: Young Tamamo
text_block_list.text:
I-It's totally white and sticky!
Pudding, what happened to ya all of a sudden!?

text_block_list.name: Young Tamamo
text_block_list.text:
W-What should I do?! If I don't eat it quick
it'll go even worse to waste?!
Gotta eat it, gotta eat it quick...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
......
An' well, a lot of stuff happened after that.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So y'know, at the end of the movie,
there was that scene where a massive swarm of slimes appeared, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That part just went all, like, yikes, and my head was just spinning with all this sticky, slimy goo...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ah... I'm starting to feel sick.
choice_data_list: Shall we take a short rest?
Shall I carry you home on my back?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine!
It'd be a total waste when we came all the way here to have fun!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You said you wanted to buy something, Trainer, and we haven't looked at it yet. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking the reluctant Tamamo Cross by the hand,
I lead her to the shopping mall's reception desk.
choice_data_list: Excuse me, is there a place where I can rest?

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'll guide you to the break room.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ugh, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, that helps.
You can actually be... pretty dependable once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, together with a recovered Tamamo Cross,
we went to eat some warm udon.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Piggyback...!?
No way, I don't wanna be treated like a kid!
choice_data_list: But she doesn't look well, so...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You're worryin' way too much. I'll kick whatever sticky nonsense is in my head outta there right now!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Sticky-sticky, round and round, begone! Sticky-sticky, round and round, sticky-sticky...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
choice_data_list: I'm carrying you home on my back after all.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That's why, I'll be fine—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...I'd love to say that,
but it's not very convincing, is it?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Forgive me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As we walked along at a leisurely pace, she seemed to have
fallen asleep before I knew it. Listening to her peaceful
snoring, I quietly made my way home.
